text:
maria.design: quick design check — I'm seeing the time-range presets overlay the sampling badge on the p95 heatmap in narrow panels. feels confusing which preset implies aggressive sampling vs. exact window. attaching a screenshot in comments later.
aj.pm: agree — noticed product teams misread '1h compact' as lower fidelity than it actually is. can we make the sampling level explicit?
leo.eng: FYI the current heuristics map presets -> sampling: {short: 100% realtime, compact: 50% prefix cache, archive: heavy-aggregation}. It's not surfaced in the UI today.
sarah.data: +1 to surfacing. Also the p95 can swing drastically with aggressive sampling, we should warn in the inline tooltip. maybe show a small shimmer when sampling applied? :thinking_face:
maria.design: proposal: rename presets to 'Live (no sampling)', 'Latency-optimized (partial sampling)', 'Cost-optimized (aggr)'. Add a tiny label under the preset chips: "sampling: 0% / 50% / 90%".
aj.pm: that naming is clearer. can we shorten copy for compact spaces? e.g., chip label 'Live — 0%' on small view.
leo.eng: doable. backend exposes sampling_pct per-query so the frontend can render exact values. also we can make the sampling badge a tappable control that opens a mini-popup with exact details and a "show raw" toggle.
ux-bot: accessibility note: ensure chips have aria-pressed state, and the sampling popup is keyboard-trappable. color contrast on the 'shimmer' needs 4.5:1 for WCAG if used as text.
maria.design: thanks. open question: do we want to alter the p95 visual calculation to show both sampled and estimated? sarah?
sarah.data: we can compute "sampled p95" and a simple adjusted estimate (bootstrapped). two lines would clutter the chart. alternative: small pill next to p95 value: "p95 (sampled)" and on hover show estimated.
aj.pm: sounds good. keep default simple, reveal more on hover and in the details panel.
leo.eng: implementation note — adding a second value in the series increases query cost but we can gate it behind the sampling popup or when user enables 'show estimates'.
maria.design: mock updates: 1) chip text change, 2) sampling pct sublabel, 3) tappable sampling badge, 4) p95 pill with hover estimate. I'll post updated Figma in an hour.
aj.pm: action items: maria update mock, leo prototype badge interaction, sarah provide a short sentence for the tooltip about expected variance, ux-bot to run accessibility checklist on new chip states.
maria.design: thanks all. small copy help: suggestion for tooltip text — 'This view uses sampling to reduce query cost. Results may under/over-estimate tail latency. Click to view raw samples.' thoughts?
sarah.data: that's good. maybe replace 'under/over-estimate' with 'bias' -> 'Results may be biased for tail latency.' more concise.
maria.design: perfect. I'll use that. closing for now, will ping when figma is ready :sparkles:
